name: Band Kneeling Rotational Crunch
steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead, kneel beneath it with hips tall, and hold the ends beside your temples.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked steadily over your knees.
Curl your rib cage downward while rotating one shoulder smoothly toward your opposite knee against the band.
Uncurl back to upright and rotate toward the other knee next, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Hold the band ends fixed beside your temples so your abs rather than your arms do the work.
Keep your hips still instead of sitting back toward your heels during the crunch.
